# no-duplicate-heading

- ID: `MD024`
- Category: Headings
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `headings`

No two headings have exactly the same text.

## Why

Some renderers, such as GitHub, build link anchors from heading text. Repeated
headings get numbered anchors, so a link that uses the text alone reaches only
the first one.

## Options

Set them under `rules.no-duplicate-heading.options`.

- `siblings_only` (`boolean`, default `false`): Report a duplicate only among
  headings that share a parent heading.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix. Only the author can choose new heading text.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

## Install

Run the installer.

## Install

Or build the tool from source.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
7:1 Duplicate heading text "Install" (first occurrence on line 3)
```

This document follows the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

## Install with the installer

Run the installer.

## Build from source

Or build the tool from source.
```

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  no-duplicate-heading:
    options:
      siblings_only: false
```

Under `rules`, `no-duplicate-heading: false` turns the rule off and
`no-duplicate-heading: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-duplicate-heading` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-duplicate-heading -->
```
